articleTitle: Cassava Leaf Disease Recognition Using Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: This study aims to investigate various kinds of convolutional neural networks to classify cassava leaf diseases. The objectives are that we want to survey the performance of current well-known CNN models including VGGs, ResNet, DenseNet, and Inception in term of classification performance and plan to extend the study of cassava disease recognition in the future. From our experiments, the best model is DenseNet121 with brightness augmentation, which achieves classification accuracy at 94.32% and F1-score at 92.13%.

articleTitle: Perspective on SDSB Human Visual Knowledge and Intelligence for Happiness Campus
abstract: Suffering globally by COVID-19 since 2020 constrained learner and worker outdoors, of which campus and public area naturally met environmental protection issue. In such cases, a newly AI moveable application, naming Self-Driving Sweeper Bot (SDSB), is invented by intelligently coordinating between self-driving system and sweeper mechanism. In this paper, the perspective on SDSB in terms of human visual knowledge and intelligence between pedestrian security and sweeping efficiency in campus is reported. To reach such a goal, our investigation is shown that human visual knowledge and intelligence, played a critical role requiring routinely collecting and learning visual dataset, accompanied with optimizing procedure by exploring the object recognition methods e.g., CNN, R-CNN, Fast-RCNN and Yolo, for detecting campus objects (including, pedestrians, vehicles, common rubbishes, i.e. fallen leaves, waste papers, plastic bottles etc.), and image segmentation techniques e.g., U-net for constraining sweeping road. In the preliminarily experiments, observation is shown that the factors for object detection and road segmentation in terms of weather, sunshine direction and shadowing/non-shadowing by trees and facilities are highly influencing on SDSB visual intelligence.

articleTitle: Spiking Neural Network (SNN) for Crop Yield Prediction
abstract: Crop yield prediction focuses mostly on agricultural research, which have an enormous impact on taking decisions for example import-export, price, along with crop management. Accurate forecasting with well-timed projections is critical, but it is a challenging undertaking owing to various complicated aspects. There are few examples of crops that can be utilized to forecast crop yields like Wheat, peas, rice, pulses, tea, sugar cane, green houses, cotton, soybeans, and corn. Agriculture needs massive datasets and awareness practices. Meteorological conditions, components of soil, management methods, genotype, and their connections are utilized to predict corn yield. Optimal crop growth frequently requires a detailed knowledge of the operational relationships among yield and these interaction parameters, that needs large datasets and difficult algorithms to demonstrate. Several Machine Learning models, Deep Learning models, and Artificial Neural Network methods are used to forecast. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Spiking Neural Networks (SNN), and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) are used to estimate corn production (RNN). By integrating RNN and SNN models, each model functioning was improved.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of AMR Robot Based on RGBD, VSLAM and SLAM
abstract: In recent years, robots have gradually entered life from the factory. Since robots that can move autonomously can improve the productivity of personnel, mobile robots are even more commonly used. With the advancement of hardware technology, improving the performance of LIDAR and depth cameras and reducing the required cost, robots can be equipped with these devices to make positioning and movement more accurate. This thesis implements an AMR robot on TurtleBot3 Burger by combining 2D LIDAR, RGBD camera and related safety devices. The data of 2D LIDAR is the input of SLAM and path planning, build 2D map and detect whether there are obstacles so that the robot can dodge; RGBD camera is used as the input of VSLAM, build 3D map, landmark database, show trajectory of the robot in 3D space and verify whether the robot has moved to the correct place. In the VSLAM algorithm, object detection and OCR technology are added to extract semantic data from the image. The 3D map and landmark database can provide users with more meaningful information. The landmark database can be used to compare the similarity of SURF features and SSIM with the images obtained when the robot is moving, to verify whether there is movement to the correct place, to improve the accuracy of the robot’s movement. The state lights, anti-falling, power detection and warning voice implemented by Arduino and related sensors are used as the safety device of the robot, so that the robot can make higher safety during operation.

articleTitle: Research on The New Drones Design to Improve Transportation of Supplies and Medical Care for Remote Mountain Area in Taiwan
abstract: With the development of science and technology, drone transportation has gradually become an important transportation and has an impact on many places. In the past, there were many rural and mountain tribes in the world or in Taiwan. They were roadless or had to across the mountains to transport materials with couple hours. This is very inconvenience for the residents in the remote villages and mountain tribes, and even important medical supplies such as blood, medicine or other healthcare items cannot be delivered immediately. This paper proposes a new type of UAV model design to solve the above transportation problem in remote mountainous areas in Taiwan, especially in medical supply delivery. The paper discusses the advantages and disadvantages of the proposed new UAV models. In addition, the flight advantages of the new UAV model in Taiwan mountainous terrain also with be discussed in this paper. The purpose of this research is to use new drones to improve the transportation of supplies and medical care in remote mountain tribes in Taiwan, which will promote more timely, efficient, and economical transportation of supplies and medical care by drones, therefore so that people can get help as soon as possible in the emergency.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Impact on Digital Content Marketing Research
abstract: This study addresses how AI will change the development of content marketing. Content marketing refers to marketing strategies executed by the means of creating and releasing valuable content to help attract and retain the targeted audience. With the flourishing of social media, as well as smart technology with AI advancement, the content marketing faces radical innovation opportunities and challenges. Thus, this research aims to review and propose development strategies of content marketing with AI technology. The study discussed the issue with the frame of content creation, channel distribution, marketing effect, and strategy adjustment. We propose that with promise of AI advancement, content marketing would have the opportunities to get even closer to the customers and precisely obtain their insight. In addition, this advantage would enhance if well prepared for the challenges in the safekeeping of personal data and building trust with the customers.

articleTitle: Emotional Speech Analysis Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: In recent studies, speech emotion recognition has been an intriguing and arduous area of research in human behavior analysis. The goal of this research area is to classify people’s emotional states according to their speech tones. At present, the research area focuses on identifying the effectiveness of automatic classifiers of speech emotions to improve the classification efficiency in practical applications, e.g., for use in telecommunication services, identifying positive emotions (e.g., happy, surprise) and negative emotions (e.g., sad, angry, disgust, and fear), which can supply a large number of valid information for platform users and customers of telecommunication services.In this paper, the complex task of identifying positive and negative emotions in human voice data is investigated by using deep learning techniques. Five open emotion speech datasets are used to train multi-level models for positive and negative emotion recognition. The experimental results shows that our model can obtain good results for both positive and negative emotion speech data.

articleTitle: Extreme Weather Event (Cyclone) Detection in India Using Advanced Deep Learning Techniques
abstract: Detection and Prediction of extreme weather events have always been important and challenging task, which has become very significant while the whole world is experiencing adverse effect of climate change. The cyclone, one of the extreme weather events has become very often and intense in Indian sub-continent areas in last few decades and its accurate detection and prediction has become very relevant. In this direction, machine learning (ML) based approached has become very popular than other conventional methods. However, the performance of the traditional ML based approaches is highly dependent on hand crafted feature engineering. In contrast, deep learning, an advance ML eliminates such barrier and selects the feature set automatically in hierarchical way, which has already displayed significant performance in various domain of research including weather forecasting. In this purpose, convolutional long-short term memory (ConvLSTM) can efficiently extract spatial and temporal information, which are very important for accurate detection of extreme weather events. Therefore, a model with ConvLSTM has been proposed in this work to detect and predict the cyclone in India. For validation, Community Atmospheric Model (CAM5.1) image data considering seven variables have been generated and employed. Two matrices, peak signal to noise ratio (PSNR) and structural index similarity (SSIM) have been used to validate the model performance. The results and analysis show that the proposed idea can effectively improve the cyclone detection and predication.

articleTitle: A Real and Novel Smart Agriculture Implementation with IoT Technology
abstract: There’s an old saying in Chinese, “food first, ethical niceties second.” It tells us how important it is to solve the food crisis. However, for the past decades, because the natural environment changes enormously, pests and disease occur more frequently, and higher and higher manpower costs need to be paid, the traditional agriculture is facing lots of new challenges. In order to address these issues, agricultural technologies with IoT technologies are proposed, but most people consider smart agriculture (smart farming) or called intelligent agriculture as planting crops with different sensors that can give farmers a dashboard to show lots of different numerical information. Some people even call this “Agriculture 4.0.”[1] In this paper, we will try to give a more clear definition of “Smart Agriculture” from our point of view. Furthermore, in our work, we tried to implement what we call a complete smart agriculture solution in one shot, especially for the most common hard-working smallholder farmers. In addition, we also implemented the proposed solution named TIAGA in real rural areas. We’ll discuss and show the results of one of the successful examples in this paper. We hope that through this paper, we can provide some new directions for the development of smart agriculture and improve the lives of the most hard-working smallholder farmers in traditional rural areas.

articleTitle: Rib Fracture Diagnosis System on Chest X-Rays with Deep Learning
abstract: Chest X-Rays is an important imaging modality for diagnosing thorax diseases. However, it is a challenging task to identify rib fractures. The features of rib fractures including various shapes, various sizes, and might overlapped by other organs. It is then time consuming and hard for clinicians to deal with it. Hence, automatically rib fractures recognition is important to clinicians. In this work, we trained two deep convolutional neural networks in order to classify rib fractures in chest x-ray images. One for frontal view images, and another for oblique view images. We present a two-stage method including lung field cropping with U-Net [1] and rib fracture classification with EfficientNet- B0 [2]. We evaluated models’ classification performance using Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUROC), Area Under Precision Recall Curve (AUPRC), and Accuracy. Class Activation Maps (CAMs) were provided to know the image regions most relevant to the model’s prediction.

articleTitle: Movie Recommendation System Using Deep Learning
abstract: It is a challenge to design a movie recommendation system with artificial intelligent technology. It is difficult to get satisfactory results as not all data is reliable and valuable from the internet. To solve this problem, researchers recommend using a recommendation system which presents relevant information instead of searching the same information multiple times. Generally, collaborative filtering methods based on user information (such as gender type, geographical area, or preference) are effective. However, in today’s era, everyone is concerned about suggestions or guidelines so that he/she can make the decision, our area of research includes movies recommendation system by which we can provide the list of similar movies to the user. Now the user is assisted with some lists of movies recommended to the user by our model, he/she only has to decide which movie he should watch next. Instead of looking into the whole list it’s better to have some recommendations based on which he/she can decide easily. The overall performance for the purposed framework resulted in an accuracy of 66% which is good for such initiative.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Drug Sorting System in Warehouse Based on 3D Camera and Cooperative Robot
abstract: Pharmacy automation system is more and more widely adopted in hospital pharmacy and large pharmacy with the development of modern medical service. A warehouse automatic drug sorting system is designed based on 3D camera, cooperative robot, PLC, AGV and touch screen in order to improve the efficiency of drug sorting. The system carries out medicine box transportation through AGV, controlling the system action flow through PLC. The 3D camera is adopted for image acquisition, image processing, target positioning and the conversion between image coordinates and robot coordinates. The cooperative robot reads the camera detection data in real time and performs sorting actions as required. The system can be adopted to sort medicine boxes with a variety of different color labels to realize the automation of drug sorting operation.

articleTitle: Online Virtual Art Exhibition Solution Based on Krpano
abstract: Building a virtual art gallery through panoramic technology can make online exhibitions more realistic and immersive, enabling visitors to experience the feeling similar to the real venues through the interactive operation. This paper analyzes the application status and implementation algorithm of panoramic tour technology. To break through the direct effects of traditional offline exhibitions on this foundation, we try to apply panoramic technology to virtual art galleries’ presentations. This paper proposed a panoramic tour interactive technical process specifically for art exhibitions and constructed the virtual reality interactive exhibition hall system embedded in Html5. It is a new digital interactive solution for art galleries and exhibitions adopted by the Art Museum of Central Academy of Fine Arts in China.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling and Mobility Pattern Analysis
abstract: The predictive modeling process begins once a set of current or historical data is collected for analysis. Then data scientists or analysts create algorithms and statistical models, train them with subsets of the data and run them against the full data set to generate the predictive model. In many cases, multiple models are used at once to create one prediction. While the terms predictive modeling and predictive analytics are sometimes used interchangeably. Modeling can be seen instead as the hands-on part of analytics applications. Mobility report from Google can impact many areas of life including economy and also matters to policy maker, with such mobility data as well as analysis we can also predict.

articleTitle: Controlling the Electric Wheelchair Using the Occlusal Myoelectric Signal
abstract: In this paper, we proposed the electric wheelchair using the occlusal myoelectric signal. Analyze the current electric wheelchairs used by patients with reduced mobility to discuss the advantages and disadvantages, and use the Labview platform to analyze the signals to determine the feasibility of using the occlusal signal to control the electric wheelchair.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Disaster Emergency Life Support Learning System
abstract: With the extreme and global disaster situations in this new century, the sustainable development of human beings has seriously affected. How to guarantee the rescue work efficiency of the healthcare professionals in the situations of disasters, and additionally to provide basic self-protection to the public people, has become an important research issue. However, it is not enough to provide enough training to the relevant medical professionals by only relying on the traditional off-line training. In this work, we designed and implemented an on-line learning system about the disaster emergency knowledges and skills for providing the more flexible learning channels and improving the learning efficiency for learners. This system is implemented by Python, HTML5 and Django MTV framework. It can be provided to the learners and teachers. In the learner client, the main functions includes courseware, questionnaire, examinationination and certificate. In the teacher client, the training results can be collected, and the learning feedback is provided through data visualization and natural language processing. This can facilitate teachers to be informed of learners’ learning more intuitively and efficiently. Finally, this system combined with exploratory data analysis to explore the comprehensive factors affecting the training effect, which can provide decision information for the developing a new round program, and contribute to a positive cycle of teaching development. This work deliver the learning system to provides an effective aid for training disaster medical professionals and to improve the overall disaster emergency response capability.

articleTitle: Prediction and analysis of HIV/AIDS incidence based on ARIMA model in China
abstract: China is one of the largest HIV/AIDS epidemic countries globally, and the number of new cases discovered every year is increasing. So, it is important to formulate and strengthen the prevention measures of the HIV/AIDS epidemic. In this work, we use time series analysis to predict the incidence of HIV/AIDS. We found ARIMA(2,1,2)(1,0,1) is the most effective model for the prediction of HIV/AIDS incidence. The prediction results of the model show that the incidence of HIV/AIDS in China will continue to rise in the future. In addition, December is the highest incidence period of HIV/AIDS and February is the lowest incidence period. At the same time, the model is used to predict the increase in the incidence of HIV/AIDS in the eastern, western, and central regions of China. The forecast results show that the incidence of HIV/AIDS in the central and eastern regions have increased steadily, while the incidence of HIV/AIDS in the western region has increased rapidly. The above conclusions can provide references for China’s HIV/AIDS prevention and control work in the next few years.

articleTitle: Feature Selection for Intradialytic Blood Pressure Value Prediction Using GRU-based Method Under RFECV algorithm
abstract: Cardiovascular events is a common complication in dialysis patients and might has relation to intradialytic blood pressure (BP) variability. This study aimed to use the new method of feature selection to improve the performance of BP value prediction. We used feature importance by a different model to sort from high to low one by one, then we obtained the combination of feature values that have the highest accuracy for predictive power, which was later disclosed as BP. Later we compared recursive feature elimination with cross-validation (RFECV) mode with non-RFECV mode, both followed by gated recurrent units (GRU), to determine which is better in this clinical situation. The results showed that the former is more accurate both under , and the predictive power is better at 100–160 mmHg, especially around 130mmHg. Nevertheless, the BP prediction in clinical use should be applied according to individual condition of each patient.

articleTitle: Research on the Professional Identity of College Students in the Context of Information Technology Development
abstract: Regarding the rapid development of information and communication technology, this study examines the determining factors in formation of professional identity (PI) for the undergraduate students. Moreover, an attempt is made to compare the PI between two groups of students who were studying in different majors. Participants consisted of 393 students who were majoring in Information Management and Information System(IMIS) (n=149, 38%) and E-Commerce(EC) (n=244,62%) in Lingnan Normal University. Survey data shows that the level of PI of the overall students is not high. In terms of the majors, the average level of PI with the various dimensions for students in Information Management and Information System is lower than the average level of that for students in E-Commerce. On the other hand, there are significant positive correlations between students’ PI and the development of information technology, as well as talent development program. Findings are also discussed in terms of their relevance among various factors of PI.

articleTitle: New prevention and control measures under epidemic situation: community epidemic prevention and control management system
abstract: Along with the continuous outbreak of COVID-19, countries all over the world have taken measures to prevent and control the virus, moreover, the pandemic measures taken in the communities are the most strict ones in particular. Currently, the health data of residents is collected manually in most communities when the pandemic is stable to some extent. Then, the pandemic risks confronted by residents are assessed accordingly, however, only the minority of communities verify the health identities of residents by scanning their health code. In such a background, the completed and humanized platform systems have not yet been designed and promoted in the market for further pandemic prevention and control. This system distinguishes the administrator from the user, the user homepage mainly has the function of viewing the announcement, the problem feedback, the membership application, the volunteer service and so on. The administrator homepage has the functions of registered user management, isolation audit management, volunteer service management, access management and so on. In addition, based on the fundamental pandemic prevention measures, the system is also endowed with function as big data analysis, which can analyze the epidemic data of inland provinces in China at the present stage to further strengthen epidemic prevention and control. Prevent infected people from entering the community and form a large-scale infection.

articleTitle: Discovering the Research Issues of Classical Chinese Segmentation via Modern Chinese Segmentation System
abstract: Word segmentation is the specific issue for Chinese in the natural language processing(NLP) domain. After several decades, there are some Chinese segmentation systems, such as CKIP and Jeiba, which are available for Chinese NLP applications. However, these systems are designed for the modern Chinese, not for the classical Chinese. In this work, we tried to apply the modern Chinese segmentation systems on the classical Chinese articles to find the research issues for the classical Chinese segmentation system. One classical Chinese articles dataset has been carefully selected, processed, and organized as the experimental benchmark by the experts’ professional knowledge.

articleTitle: Revisiting Meta-Heuristic Optimization Method in solving Stochastic System Design Problem
abstract: Optimization is an important issue in the real world, and most problems can be transformed into optimization problems. However, such stochastic optimization problems are always accompanied by uncertainty, especially in the industries of innovative technologies (i.e., wearable devices and sensors on healthcare), integrated supply chain, and sustainable operations management. Due to the outbreak of COVID-19 pandemics last year, it has become quite difficult for industries to quickly obtain their supplies and optimize their operations. Therefore, a Particle Swarm Optimization Retrospective Approximation (PSORA) algorithm is proposed to solve and validate the problem using a unimodal example and sensitivity analysis. PSORA uses the framework of Retrospective approximation (RA) to iteratively solve a sequence of sample path approximation problems with increasing sample sizes; each sample path problem is solved by the improved PSO algorithm. When the sample size approaches infinite, the improved PSO algorithm solves the sample path problem to approximately identify the real objective function. Our simulation results show that PSORA is robust, and converges quickly. The result of the developed optimal model can provide marginal insights to decision-makers in problem-solving.

articleTitle: Remote Control the Drone with SSVEP
abstract: This paper uses flash stimulus as a visual control signal, set 15Hz for forward, 17Hz for backward, 19Hz for left turn, 21Hz for right turn, 25Hz for rise, and 27Hz for fall. We use the Labview program to perform filtering and threshold calculations, the value of the threshold is transmitted to the signal receiver on the drone to control the actions of the drone. In the experiment, an average of 44 control commands were issued, There are 39.6 successfully executed instructions, the accuracy is 90.04%. Use the filtering and output file functions in the Labview program, it does not require much wiring to achieve the same functionality as the entity.

articleTitle: The Construction of Brand Image Design Course Centered on Regional Design
abstract: With the development of society, people have shifted from pure material needs to spiritual needs. Culture and creativity have gradually received widespread attention from the public, and the concept of brand has gradually expanded from the commercial field to the cultural field. In recent years, the cultural and creative industry has become a hot topic in society. The changes in the general environment have put forward new requirements for design. More regional and connotative cultural brand concepts have gradually entered people’s lives. This article mainly explains how to design a cultural brand image with more national characteristics in the design courses of colleges and universities, with regional design as the background and problem-oriented research methods.

articleTitle: New Media in Film Communication and Cultural Industry with happiness detection
abstract: New media is the most important mode of modern communication, it is kind of affective computing for happiness detection. The Frankfurt School proposes "cultural industry", which means "cultural and creative industry", and is strongly promoted all over the world. With the progress of new media communication and the trend of globalization, the film industry has a high value and high investment efficiency ratio. Through the analysis of the China film "Hi, Mon" and the Taiwan film "Our Times" in the global box office. With the development of new media big data research, the intersection of new media and box office research, it is possible to learn the importance of the collective memory of society to the society after it is reproduced in the film, thus exploring the meaning of film and cultural communication in the cultural and creative industry.

articleTitle: A Survey of Finger Vein Recognition
abstract: Many researchers are interested in finger vein identification since it is hidden beneath the skin, so it is considered more secure than other biometric features like the face, retina, fingerprint. Furthermore, finger vein collection is more easier and more hygienic than other features. There are some approaches for finger vein recognition, such as using image processing approach that focus on the hand-craft features, or deep learning approach. The deep learning approach has been demonstrated to be more beneficial than the image processing approach, especially in images with poor quality, low contract, or variations in position, rotation, or scale. This survey not only summarizes recent advances in finger vein detection but also compares several contemporary methodologies.

articleTitle: Real-Time Prediction of Intradialytic Hypotension via GRU and Explainable AI
abstract: Kidney disease is a common civilized illness for humans. The population of kidney dialysis in Taiwan exceeded 85,000 in 2017 and continued to increase by 6% per year. Intradialytic hypotension is the one of most common complication. Therefore, we hope to predict the occurrence of hypotension in the next 30 minutes as a target. However, there are too many factors that may cause hypotension, which makes it much more difficult to predict. Blood pressure and physical data are both time-dependent features. Therefore, The gated recurrent unit (GRU) network is used to predict the time series effectively. And Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanation (LIME) XAI is used to interpret the prediction results to help people understand the causes of low blood pressure. The model prediction results have good performance in both binary classification and regression. This can lead to a safer and easier hemodialysis treatment for patients.

articleTitle: An Implementation of FastAI Tabular Learner Model for Parkinson’s Disease Identification
abstract: This paper presents the implementation of the tabular learner model by FastAI for Parkinson’s disease (PD) identification. FastAI is one of the deep learning libraries that provide practitioners with high-level components that can quickly, efficiently, and easily. The dataset that we use is generated from the calculation of 29 acoustic parameters of the Multidimensional Voice Program (MDVP) in 3 different types of voice recording groups, namely PD voice, PD control voice, and Healthy voice. Our group of voice recordings was obtained from clinical assessments conducted by Taipei Medical University Hospital on PD patients and PD controls who were patients with suspected PD but not PD after clinical assessment. The healthy voice recording group we collected as a dataset contribution with a total of 55 healthy voice recording samples, 145 PD voice recording samples, and 55 control PD voice recording samples. Samples were recorded with vocal /a/ and vocal /u/ for 3 seconds with a recording distance of 5 cm, 16-bit quantization, and the sampling rate of 44.1 kHz. Our proposed model achieves the best results with an accuracy of 82%, root mean square error (RMSE) of 3.35 and mean absolute error (MAE) of 2.94 using a dataset of PD voice recordings and healthy voice recordings. It was concluded that the tabular learner model by FastAI has considerable potential for PD identification based on voice recordings.

Author Keywords: Acoustic Parameters of Multidimensional Voice Program (MDVP)

articleTitle: Study on Tourism Experience of M50 Creative Park in Shanghai Based on ASEB Grid Analysis Method
abstract: This paper is based on the research data of cultural and creative park and the questionnaire data, combined with information from online materials and field surveys. The advantages, disadvantages, opportunities and threats of tourist experience in Shanghai M50 Creative Park in four aspects of activities, environment, experience and income are analyzed by using ASEB grid analysis method. Explore the influence of each experience factor on visitor experience of M50 Creative Park, and put forward corresponding countermeasures and suggestions as well as improvement methods.

articleTitle: Automatic Telephone Interview Survey System
abstract: Nowadays, governments or enterprises often use questionnaires to investigate people’s views on issues or products, and telephone interviews are one of the most commonly used methods for questionnaire surveys. The proposed system is mainly divided into four parts. The first part is pre-processing, according to the questionnaire to be interviewed to generate the data needed in the follow-up dialogue in advance. The second part is to build a VoIP soft phone, the purpose is to realize the function of making calls on the software side with multiple SIP lines at the same time through the SIP architecture. In addition, the system also connects the front-end softphone module with the back-end dialogue module through a dialogue interface to automatically conduct the telephone interview. The third part is multi-turn question answering dialogue. If the call is answered, the dialogue module will actively ask the respondent according to the questions in the questionnaire, and then through hybrid answer matching to determine the option matched by the respondent’s answer. Finally, the dialogue module decides the question to be asked in the next turn to achieve the effect of multi-turn dialogue. The fourth part is call detail record and table generation, which is responsible for recording the call status and answering situation during the telephone interview. In addition, the system performs post-processing according to the telephone interview results of all lines after the execution, so that we can quickly understand the situation of the telephone interview survey.

articleTitle: Research on Building Lighting Intelligent Control System Based on Bus Technology
abstract: In order to change the inconvenience of management and energy waste of traditional building lighting system, this paper designs an intelligent control system of building lighting based on bus technology. The system consists of the upper computer, the control subsystem of the host computer, the control subsystem of the relay and the control subsystem of the switch. Hierarchical control method is proposed, which can support the manual operation and automatic operation mode, each corresponding lighting load switch control, upper machine and the host can be modified to set the switching time of the load, and the host and the upper machine can match from the other sensor control signal to work together, when a control signal elimination is according to the predetermined plan on or off load power supply. The system has the advantages of high efficiency, convenience, low cost, good interactivity, fast response speed and high degree of automation.

articleTitle: Proactive Operation Condition Monitoring System of High-Voltage Motors Based on CNN and LSTM
abstract: This study developed an active monitoring system for high-voltage motor operation status based on a convolutional neural network and long short-term memory neural network. The system features real-time updates, automatic feature extraction, and prediction of the trend of operation status in the following 30 minutes. The system first calculates the values of 6 core monitoring indicators of high-voltage motor operation status by measuring the actual voltage, current signals, vibration acceleration signals, and temperature of an operating high-voltage motor. Next, the values of the 6 indicators in the preceding 100 minutes are used to predict the trend of changes in these values in the next 30 minutes. This study employed 5 common statistical and machine learning prediction models to determine the maximum error between the predicted and actual operation status in the following 30 minutes in relation to the 6 indicators. The results revealed that the incorporation of a convolutional neural network effectively reduced the training time and that the long short-term memory neural network exhibited the optimal prediction outcome. Finally, according to related international motor operation guidelines, the high-voltage motor operation status was predicted by subtracting the maximum error value from the international threshold value, through which to achieve active monitoring of operation status, reduce the incidence of faults, and lower maintenance costs.

articleTitle: Influencing Factors of Urban Residents’ Social Capital - Based on the Analysis of Survey Data in Shanghai and Shenzhen
abstract: Social capital embodies an important indicator of individual social resources. Existing studies have found that individual social capital can play a decisive role in the decision-making of social actions. However, the research on the influencing factors of social capital is still insufficient. Based on the questionnaire survey in Shanghai and Shenzhen, this paper discusses the influencing factors of personal social capital by multiple regression method. The results show that household registration, marital status and trust in the community have different degrees of influence on personal social capital. Through the interactive analysis of the data between the two cities, it is found that the trust in the community has different influences on social capital in the two cities, which may be related to the different grass-roots governance models in the two cities.

articleTitle: The Pilot Research of Differencing Time Series as an Important Feature Extraction for Numerical Prediction of Systolic Blood Pressure Using Machine Learning
abstract: Intradialytic hypotension (IDH) is a critical complication leading to risk of mortality during hemodialysis (HD). This study devises tentative research in using differencing time series as an important feature extraction by using machine learning models to predict the occurrence of IDH to activate precaution. In this tentative research, compared with the results with or without a difference, the mean absolute error (MAE) with the difference is 11.316, which shows slightly better performance than the results without difference. Also, the results of numerical experiments, which show the differencing value as a feature to remove a random or stochastic trend of time-related data and to make the time series stationary, are presented.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Agile High Potential Talent Identification System Based on Big Data Technology
abstract: In the era of VUCA, enterprises need to quickly and accurately identify high-potential talents to achieve enterprise development and transformation. This article will talent radar, data, image, big data technologies, such as tendency analysis and Merce post evaluation methods, behavioral event interview, evaluation center technology and so on to carry on the organic combination, build agile high latent talent identification system, to establish high latent talent ability quality model, establish other agile high dive into the well path and the specification, as to provide theoretical basis for enterprise agile high latent talent identification.

articleTitle: Problem-Based Practical Training Awared Course Recommendation System
abstract: In face of the rising of Industry 4.0, initial and gradual changes are taking place on the industry workers and education. The Industry 4.0 complex characteristics bring more challenges for vocational education. To solve the education problem of live demonstration and real-time practical activities in such complex subjects, a problem-based practical training real-time recommendation system is design and implement fitting for the practical education scenario. Based on big data technologies, it identifies the student behavior patterns when they met the problem and illustrate them not only the solution methods but also the theory behind the problem phenomenon with an intuitive and intelligible manner. We found that the recommendation education system was better to encourage positive empathy, improve individual’s scores and comprehensive qualities.

articleTitle: Research on the Development of Shanghai Tourism Industry Cluster
abstract: With the rapid development of the tourism industry, the adjustment and integration of the tourism industry structure, The clusters of the tourism industry has become an inevitable trend. During the period of accelerated development of the modern service industry, Shanghai’s tourism industry has been significantly affected by the production service industry, professional service industry, information service industry, technical service industry, and creative service industry. There has been a trend of Industrial Cluster. The government is also attaching great importance to the tourism industry clusters. This article judges the current situation of Shanghai’s tourism industry clusters, analyzes the current situation of Shanghai’s tourism clusters through two aspects of agglomeration and concentration, then summarizes the characteristics of Shanghai’s tourism industry clusters.

articleTitle: Savior: An Interactive Game Device for Environmental Protection
abstract: This paper presents Savior, an interactive device based on the thinking on the environmental problems, which people can interact with through their behavior. Pictures of the world map are displayed on the electronic screen, this screen is supposed to show both terrible scenes and beautiful scenes of the earth. 3D printed models are embedded with different Arduino sensors. This interactive installation is also an interesting game installation which is attractive to people and it can involve people in the interactive game. A preliminary evaluation is conducted and indicates that Savior raised people's awareness of environmental protection. Meanwhile, it has the potential of guiding people to protect the environment in the real life and change nowadays’ negative living condition on earth. In this process, users are like the savior of the earth, they changed our earth from a terrible condition to a beautiful and prosperous world. Our contribution in this project is that we raised people's awareness of environmental protection by visualizing data of environmental problems and combine games with art installations.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of Proton Image with Ion Recombination Compensation
abstract: Pencil Beam Scanning (PBS) of proton therapy is an advanced radiation technique for cancer treatment. Due to its effective planning and control for particle-beam, the narrow pulse train and extremely high radiation dose delivering becomes more practical toward the development of flash delivery of proton beam. Benefits due to flash therapy are reducing uncertainty caused by the movement of breath and depress damage to healthy parts near tumor. But, flash therapy usually applies high proton current density to achieve high dose rate. This causes underestimation in dose measurement, because of the recombination effect of the electron-ion pairs inside ionization chamber that leads to the received electronic signal underestimated. The study proposed a novel algorithm to reconstruct the 2D image of the flash delivery of proton/particle beam. The Boag’s model of high energy physics is adopted for the estimation of the charge collecting efficiency. Based on the assumption of spatial symmetry and numerical methods, the proton beam is expected to be aligned. Consequently, in preliminary simulation, the flash proton radiation could be converted into a two-dimensional image, and the effective spatial resolution could be achieved to 1 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The simulation also revealed the charge collection efficiency will affect the proposed image reconstruction algorithm. The results matched the IAEA TRS-398 dosimetry protocol when the charge collection efficiency is greater than 0.7. It shows the proposed novel algorithm of 2D image reconstruction could be valuable for the assistance for the medical instrument quality assurance.

articleTitle: Under the Prevalence of E-Commerce: Online Bookstore System
abstract: Under the rapid development of the Internet, the rise of e-commerce, more and more people trade goods through the network. The rapid development of the network needs more and more people in the current society, so the types of online shopping malls are therefore more colorful. Online bookstores are one of them. At home or abroad, there are a lot of mature large online bookstores, which can expand the scale and influence of businesses, reduce operating costs and improve work efficiency. The network bookstore system is based on B/S structure, which can register users, search and purchase and other functions. The operation that can be carried out in physical stores can also be completed on the network, and online shopping is realized without the restriction of time and place. In order to distinguish them from traditional bookstores, there are also a series of award evaluation activities launched, where users can pay attention to each other, and also launched the module of published works to better achieve cloud interaction.

articleTitle: AI Prescription Recognition System
abstract: In order to improve the work efficiency of pharmacists, this work proposes a prescription recognition system. The prescription recognition system mainly consists of three parts, namely pre-processing, information extraction and post-processing. The pre-processing includes contrast enhancement of the input image, optical character recognition, and the merging and sorting of the characters after optical character recognition. In the information extraction part, we hybrid two different strategies, the rule-based method, and the deep learning-based method. Finally, post-processing corrects some common optical character recognition errors and performs format conversion on specific fields. On the user interface, we build a web application server with Django, which provides pharmacists to upload, edit, and manage prescriptions. In the deep-learning-based information extraction, the average F1-score reached 93.8%. In the experiment of the overall recognition system, we test 202 different prescriptions, and compare the three different information extraction strategies, which are rules-based method, deep-learning-based method, and hybrid method respectively. The hybrid method is improved in most fields, and the accuracy of all the fields in our system is greater than 93%. Finally, the system gets 4.38 point on the average opinion score.

articleTitle: The effect of self-service technology of the service quality on customer loyalty for Resort hotels in Taiwan- customer satisfaction as mediator
abstract: With the development of information technology, the setting of self-service technology has become popular. Personnel service has been gradually replaced by self-service technology, the hotel industry is gradually moving towards intelligence and self-service technology in Taiwan.This study aims to explore the impact of self-service technology of service quality on customer loyalty. From the perspective of customer satisfaction, the purpose of this study expects to help resort hotels enhance the service quality in using hotel self-service technology. There are five dimensions of service quality utilized by the "SERVQUAL" evaluation scale: tangibility, empathy, reliability, responsiveness and credibility. Amos22.0 is applied for data analysis with descriptive analysis, correlation analysis and mediating effect test analysis.Empirical implications: the service quality of self-service technology in resort hotels is positively related to customer satisfaction. Customer satisfaction roles a perfectly mediator between service quality of hotel self-service technology and customer loyalty. In order to improve customer satisfaction and achieve customer loyalty, it provides recommendation for future development of resort hotel self-service technology.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the Path for a Battle Flag Game Based on Unity 3d
abstract: This study is about the use of unity 3d to make a round game that controls the movement of characters as chess pieces. In the process of designing the realization of path function, ray detection is used to judge whether there are chess pieces on the grid and attack enemy chess pieces, and flood filling algorithm is used to detect the movable range of chess pieces. Then A star routing algorithm is used to determine the appropriate path from a chess piece to the target grid to realize the routing algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Status Quo of Caring Freshmen’s Professional Courses Learning
abstract: University learning is full of expectations for many students who graduate from high school, and many students are troubled. For freshmen, the learning environment and learning methods of the university are very different from the learning mode before high school, which makes many students don’t know how to deal with university teaching and learning for a period of time, and even feel at a loss. In professional learning, the differences in professional learning interest and professional cognition may also affect students’ professional learning and future curriculum learning, resulting in great trouble; In addition, some freshmen generally have a relaxed psychology after entering the University. Their studies begin to become lazy. Students with poor learning ability don’t know how to deal with the new environment and teaching mode. The survey results show that freshmen generally have problems such as unclear learning objectives, low enthusiasm, insufficient learning investment and passive learning, Timely adjust the current situation of students and care for corresponding measures, such as appeasing and correctly guiding students’ learning emotions, draw corresponding conclusions, and give some suggestions to improve the learning effect of professional freshmen.

articleTitle: The Demand Analysis and Forecast of APP-based Taxi Service via Machine Learning
abstract: The app-based taxi service has significantly changed the transportation market of the modern city in the last decade. It is very important to predict the demand of APP-based taxi service. In this paper, we proposed a study to analyze and forecast the demand of APP-based taxi service by using two different machine learning approaches, linear and sinusoidal regression. The Wujin District of Changzhou City in China is the study area in the experiment. The experimental result shows that the linear regression is better than the sinusoidal regression, although the request of APP-based taxi service have the periodic variation naturally. This can support the decision of the service platform and the cabdrivers.

articleTitle: Blood Pressure Value Prediction in Hemodialysis Patients Using the CNN+GRU Network Architecture
abstract: During clinical operation of Hemodialysis, Blood pressure (BP) variability, affect significant global risks and offshoot complication linked to adverse mortality. However, on this task, a prediction model has not been studied extensively with the advent of big data models. Earlier machine learning models lacked the exploitation of precise modeling regarding temporal context information affecting stratified BP values in the output. Recently deep learning models introduced hierarchical temporal feature engineering and context information for Spatio-temporal tasks, and thus this study geared to exploit the advantages of deep learning models, specially, in the form of the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model, variants of RNN models, and adaptive hybrid networks combining gated recurrent units (GRU) and CNN for the time-series tasks. In addition, a hybrid deep architecture of CNN and LSTM was employed to predict BP value and make it more efficient and effective when applied to health care. The benchmark results on our dataset for the validation of the CNN+GRU hybrid deep architecture model yielded promising contributions on the prediction task with most significant accuracy value of 72.7% corresponding to delta 15 mmHg and 83.7% when 20 mmHg.

articleTitle: How Should I Do? Users’ Attitude Toward Information Security and Data Protection Using Smartphone
abstract: Information Security and Data Protection (ISDP) nowadays are growing threatening to users as spreading Information and Connection Technology (ICT) development and smartphone using. Many identified issues about information security and data protection emerged and call for public awareness and actions. However, how users understand and ready to adopt right actions for this consumption privacy and right still not clear? Thus, this study aims to investigate users’ attitude toward to ISDP, with the framing of users’ attitude by cognition, emotion, and actions. To investigate the connection between users’ attitude and the potential threats. This study reviews some cases, related issue which proposed that users are less, following which we suggest some potential strategies for advance ISDP.

articleTitle: Wardrobe Rentals: A Study of the Fashion Industry under Sharing Economy
abstract: This paper explores the two dimensions of demand and supply of production and consumption in the fashion leasing industry, adopted the method of multiple case study, field investigation, and interview. Drawing on analysis of both demand and supply, we identified the gap between two sides, then proposed a new conceptual model of co-creation, in which combine the traditional retail business clothing model and wardrobe rentals business model to contribute the problem solving of both the demand and supply sides. Moreover, we optimize the rental platform to improve the recycling of clothing with the proposed co-creation mechanism. We argue that empower consumers to participate in the production and consumption on the new platform model, would the inspire consumers to be more creative from constraints in the traditional retail model of purchase and consumption, nor to abandon and deny changes in fashion, but to deeper changes in fashion and to achieve long-term sustainable development through the co-creation of wardrobe rentals platform.

articleTitle: The Fuzzy-Neural Network Control with SARSA Learning for Nonlinear System
abstract: This paper presents the fuzzy-neural network sliding-mode control (FNNSMC) with SARSA learning methods for tracking nonlinear system is proposed for chaos systems. A tuning methodology is derived to update weight parts of the FNNSMC which based on gradient descent. The proposed control tracking stability and error convergence to the closed-loop system could be guaranteed. Furthermore, the effectiveness of the proposed control systems is verified by simulated results.

articleTitle: The Study of Transfer of Training Model for Adult Care Education Learners
abstract: The purpose of the study was to explore the factors that inflect the transfer of learners’ training and the path of the transfer of learners’ training. Quantitative method was used for this study, the 378 adult education learners serviced from August. 1 to August 14, 2020 were returned by convenient sampling. Then, the data was analyzed by descriptive statistic, path analysis and Pearson correlation analysis. The results of the study indicated: (1) most data were provided by female, married, college graduate, 60 years old, made 30,001 to 45,000 per month; (2) Adult education learners’ self-efficacy, training design and training environment had positive influences to the training result; (3) Adult education learners’ self-efficacy, training result and training environment had positive influences to the transfer of training; (4) Adult education learners’ self-efficacy, training design and transfer of training had significant positive relation. The study of adult education learner’s promotion transfer of training effect, should be sufficient training of the former the relevant information participate more adult education learners in course training; and to strengthen learners growth training and organized short-term volunteer service work environment; organizations to provide repeatedly during the exercise of opportunities to increase training as learning result of transfer of training effect.

articleTitle: Research on “120” intelligent First Aid System in Smart City
abstract: “120” first aid belongs to the public health emergency system and is an important component of the social security system. With the support of “Internet +” cross-border innovative thinking and information technology, with emergency medical cloud data as the core, IoT and data transmission and exchange as technologies, the information in the “120” smart emergency system integrated into the smart city can be shared, communicated, integrated and applied. The system integrates emergency monitoring and early warning, intelligent decision-making and command scheduling, intelligent optimization of paths, remote medical information transmission, remote expert guidance, etc., to deliver efficient and convenient emergency medical services. It is conducive to the realization of highly knowledgeable health emergency command, decision-making and supervision, and maintains the important role of the city’s social stability, economic development and regional security.

articleTitle: Compilation of Core Competencies Scale for Vocational College Mathematics Teacher
abstract: The theoretical framework of core competencies model for vocational college mathematics teacher was research-informed which was based on both the mathematics education and vocational education. Moreover, the model was verified by means of expert interviews. Through a series of dimensional design, coding, item-selecting and evaluation, the core competencies scale for vocational college mathematics teacher was compilated. Exploratory factor analysis and confirmatory factor analysis were carried out to explore the construct validity. Results showed the scale high reliability and construct validity. The model was consistent with the theoretical framework and the data collected. It was a second-order factor model, summed up as core competencies, which had three factors-knowledge, skills and dispositions.

articleTitle: An Energy-Aware Caching Policy in Information-Centric Networking
abstract: Caching is the basis of Information-Centric Networking. Its transparent, pervasive and fine-grained features make it useful to address the network traffic explosion problem. However, traditional network caching policies only consider cache hit ratio. This paper takes energy efficiency as a major design objective for caching policies, chooses the appropriate network energy consumption model to calculate the overall energy consumption of content caching and content transmission, and then designs and implements a distributed game-based energy-aware caching decision policy (GEACD) and an energy-aware cache migration policy (EACM). Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively reduce network energy consumption.

articleTitle: A Survey of Vietnamese Automatic Speech Recognition
abstract: In this paper, we survey Vietnamese automatic speech recognition (ASR). The objective of this survey is to provide an overview of the current status and remaining challenges of implementing a Vietnamese ASR. Recently, there are some studies on ASR for Vietnamese language; however, these studies encounter some obstacles and the results obtained compared to other languages such as English or Mandarin are lower. With regards to Vietnamese speech recognition, we will examine the methods of building a system along with speech data and text data collection techniques and available speech resources. We review both the methods applied to acoustic modeling and those used to language modeling. In addition, we convey some directions for future research.

articleTitle: Complaining Behavior Predicting Model for Electric Customers Based on Stochastic Forest Algorithm
abstract: With the rapid development of economy and society, power customers require higher quality for power supply, which puts forward higher requirements for electric power service. Obviously, high quality service is vital to survival and development of power enterprises. Due to the lack of effective warning analysis of customer power failure, it is impossible for power enterprises to carry out scientific scheduling according to the urgency of customer fault emergency repair, resulting in poor customer service experience and prominent customers’ demolition problems. Based on historical repair information of customers in the power industry and combined with the indicators such as repair efficiency, external environment and customer historical complaint times, this paper proposes a complaining behavior predicting model (CBPM) for electric customers by exploiting RFC random forest and the grid search algorithm to optimize the model parameters. Our model can be used by power enterprises to predict the complaint risk of current circulating work orders, and quickly locate the work orders with high complaint tendency, thereby guiding the customer service department to take targeted measures. Theory and practice show that our CBPM mode outperforms existing complaining behavior predicting methods, and our prediction model can effectively realize the pre-warning of complaints, thereby reducing the amount of customer complaints and improving customer satisfaction effectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of Tourism Industry in Fenghuang in West Hunan
abstract: With its superior position at the junction of South Sichuan, East Guizhou and West Hunan, Fenghuang in west Hunan is rich in tourism resources. The development of tourism industry has greatly driven the rapid development of local economy. However, there are some disadvantages here, which restrict the development of tourism industry. This paper discusses the development strategy of Fenghuang tourism industry cluster in west Hunan, hoping to promote the competitiveness of Fenghuang tourism in west Hunan through the development of tourism industry cluster.

articleTitle: Research on Employee Assistance Program: Progress and Trend
abstract: Based on citation analysis and knowledge map visual analysis, a study of 1031 journal literature data in the field of employee assistance program (EAP) research in the web of science database from 1900 to 2021 found that: since the first research article related to Employee Assistance Program published in 1974, EAP research has entered an outbreak period since the 1990s, and the number of literature and citations have basically increased year by year; It mainly focuses on the subthemes of workplace, stress, depression, care, health, alcohol, burnout, etc; The United States, Canada and Australia ranked the top three in number and quality of the research articles, forming eight types of cooperation among countries (regions) and academic institutions, and the aggregate of the total volume and quality of Chinese mainland have a big gap. Roman, PM and other scholars and their literature have great influence in the field of employee assistance program, which has formed five academic community factions.

articleTitle: The influence of wedding banquet labor outsourcing on customers and internal employees in terms of happiness and satisfaction - A case study on the Yixing Hotel
abstract: Hosting weddings, graduation dinners, teacher appreciation banquets, family banquets and other activities at hotels are very popular in mainland China, the income of banquets and weddings has been considered as a major revenue generator for the hotels. With the high demand for weddings, Yixing Hotel opened three new banquet halls in 2018 and started to use outsourcing employees to assist in serving wedding banquets. This study collected the history data of hotel internal employee surveys and wedding customer surveys to identify the impact of wedding banquet labor outsourcing on customers and internal employees in terms of happiness and satisfaction. The primary data was conducted monthly from October 2018 to March 2021 through SINOTRUST, a consulting company. From February to April of 2020 were not considered in the analysis because these three months had no wedding banquet due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Therefore, a total amount of 26 cases were sorted out in the sample. To test the hypotheses, this study used the classic linear regression model and empirical model and conducted the factor analysis and the regression analysis. The results of this study identified that outsourcing activities affected the happiness and satisfaction of wedding banquet customers; the outsourcing activity has a negative effect on internal employees’ happiness and job satisfaction through three dimensions - colleague relationships, job security, and reasonableness of work assignments. Through the case study, the managerial implications and theoretical implications are provided to Yixing and similar-type hotels regarding the aforementioned dimensions.

articleTitle: The Implementation of Hybrid Electric Vehicle Battery Fault and Abnormal Early Warning System Using Keras Neural Network Technology
abstract: This paper proposed a method that makes use of Keras artificial neural network (ANN) technology to develop a power battery failure and abnormal warning system for hybrid electric vehicles. The proposed method applies the on-board diagnostic (OBD) interface to collect driving data of hybrid electric vehicles, such as vehicle speed, engine speed, engine cooling water temperature, engine load, accelerator pedal position, control module voltage, main battery voltage as well as current, hybrid vehicle charging status, intake air temperature, airflow, and etc. Then, these data are preprocessed to extract 6 characteristic fields. In the meanwhile, the airflow and vehicle speed data are used to calculate the fuel consumption characteristic field. All these characteristic fields are normalized to between 0 and 1. Finally, a fault warning model for the power battery system of a hybrid electric vehicle is constructed through the Keras ANN. The input layer, hidden layer, and output layer of the Keras ANN used in this paper are 7, 6, and 10 neurons, respectively. This paper uses the 2019 Toyota Prius C as an experimental vehicle. The experimental results show that the proposed power battery failure and abnormal warning system have an accuracy rate of 97.83%. The experimental results also show that the performance of the Keras ANN model is better than that of the decision tree algorithm, random forest tree algorithm, support vector machine, and k-nearest neighbor classification algorithms. The results of this paper have an extremely high application value of the Internet of Vehicles (IoV), especially for the fault detection/warning of hybrid electric vehicles.

Author Keywords: Power battery of hybrid electric vehicles

articleTitle: The Influence of Tourism Consumption on Quality of Life in Mainland China
abstract: The experience economy has become one of the main economic transformations globally. This paper used CFPS datasets to study the influence of tourism, which is one type of experience economy, on the quality of life of people in Mainland China. It finds that Among all life stages, tourism consumption has the most positive influence on adults’ quality of life in the aspects of psychological status, family relations, satisfaction with the environment, and general life quality. The amount of their travel expenditure also influences their quality of life positively.
